verdict.rationale: Brex's marketing says it can 'automatically block out-of-policy purchases, with preset rules and limits' with 'auto-enforced controls,' and its Budgets API manages spend limits, including monthly user limits via integrations. That covers amount limits and policy-based blocking. However, nothing in the evidence documents restricting cards by merchant category or by specific merchant. The point-of-sale decline claim also rests only on marketing copy. Missing for 10: documented category/MCC and merchant-level card restrictions, technical docs on real-time authorization declines or auto-locks, independent or hands-on corroboration.
